question: Reusable mixed-language OCR gold and deterministic geometry providers

sources.reason: Closest genre and Greek/Latin-script mix, but no French and no exhaustive page-level line/read-order contract.

Historical line detection and ordering in one model; bfloat16 and distribution feasibility remain gates.
Historical baseline/line segmentation with PAGE output; model provenance must be pinned.
Lightweight detection-only control; reading order must be supplied deterministically by M PDF.
Already integrated and produces coordinate-bearing TSV/hOCR.
